design.selection: one seed, every generated document and every pair
design.profiles: five overlapping IT specialties, forty resumes each, two vacancies each
design.transition: index%4==1: add one skill from the next specialty if not already in this role stack
design.omission: one positive ability missing from text when size>=3 and index%3==0
design.context_only: index%5==2: one technology used by another team, explicitly no personal experience
design.surface_forms: fixed authored variants, selected with the registered seed
design.experience: fixed closed periods, optional explicit total; ten unspecified values
design.score: production formula, weights, model and dictionary unchanged
design.thresholds: same five numerical PMI limits; failure is an allowed recorded outcome
design.layout_status: authored HH-style sections; not an official HH export
design.external_validity: diagnostic stress test; not a representative real corpus or the presentation experiment

design_context: difficulty scenarios selected after observing the previous easy synthetic benchmark; not an independent blind validation
